notes: Buyer Individual ledger (Betel) redesigned to read like the book: one row per day with the weekday shown (25/08/2026 [Tue]), a single merged Date, Payment and Balance per day, a Payment column instead of separate payment rows, and the account split into Current (open cycle) vs History (earlier settled cycles) with the carried-forward Opening (முன்) shown. History detects a settle (நேர்) when a payment squares the carried balance before that day's new purchases. Left pane gains a date-range filter and an All/Betel/Payment toggle. Amount columns keep the ₹ in a straight column, close to the digits. Clicking a Split/Invoice link, editing and pressing Update now returns you to the same buyer's ledger instead of Home.
